caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile swatch featuring a pattern divided vertically into two contrasting halves. The left half consists mainly of a red and green background with white floral and foliate motifs, while the right half displays a dark blue background with similar white floral and foliate designs. In the lower center, a bird motif is outlined in white, spanning partly across both halves, positioned against the red on the left and the blue on the right. The textile has uneven, loose fringe at the bottom edge, colored red on the left and blue on the right. The swatch is illustrated on a plain beige background, and the name "Alois E. Ulrich" is written below the drawing.
title: Jacquard Coverlet (Detail)
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
